verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for developer.moneybird.com/llms.txt, described as documentation files for large language models, and the marketing site also serves an llms.txt that indexes the MCP, CLI, API and webhook docs. Markdown doc pages such as introduction.md and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec give agents further machine-readable sources. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and markdown variants are not uniformly available (the root .md probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote:
PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.moneybird.com/llms.txt # Moneybird API Documentation

> Documentation files for Large Language Models
Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
Moneybird publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document in its vendor GitHub organization
